config.author: PI/OpenAI
config.selection: Two fixed generic descriptions per animal crossed with two wrappers, chosen before extraction. No animal names, evaluated properties or answer labels in prompts. Descriptions are not perfectly unambiguous; lengths differ. No output-based replacement, rescaling or dose search. Tests preparation data under ordinary addition, not a new algebraic method or isolated component.
